name: Fragile Parcels
tagline: Send fragile parcels to the Fragile Block and all other parcels to the Standard Block.
brief: Send each fragile parcel to the Fragile Block. Send every other parcel to the Standard Block.
context: Parcels arrive one at a time. Some parcels are fragile, and some are not.
narrative:
Welcome to the mail room.

Parcels arrive one at a time. Some of them break easily, like a glass vase or light bulbs. These parcels have a FRAGILE label.

Fragile parcels go to the Fragile Block. All other parcels go to the Standard Block.

For each parcel, you make one choice: which block does it go to?
objective: Sort all eight parcels. Every parcel must end up in the right block.
learningObjective: How to make a yes-or-no choice: do one thing when something is true, and another thing when it is not.
intelligenceExplanation:
Right now there are no rules. The parcels wait and nothing moves.

Your task: build a rule that sends every fragile parcel to the Fragile Block. Then build a rule that sends every other parcel to the Standard Block.

Rules are checked from the top, and the first rule that is true wins. So the order of your rules matters.
hint: Think about two cases: fragile parcels, and every other parcel.
hints: Look at the parcels. The fragile ones have a FRAGILE label. Is there a fact in the Conditions tab that tells you this?
You need one rule for fragile parcels and one rule for everything else. Think about which one should be checked first.
Answer: WHEN isFragile -> DO send-to-fragile-block. Then, below it, WHEN always -> DO send-to-standard-block.
